links.outcome: Trainee demand for AI education versus availability of AI teaching in training programmes
links.effect: 98.7% felt AI should be taught in training; only one respondent reported their programme had implemented AI teaching; 71.4% had no experience working with AI.
links.quote: Almost all (98.7%) felt that AI should be taught during their training, yet only one respondent stated that their training programme had implemented AI teaching.

screen.reason: Survey of UK radiology trainees assessing attitudes, knowledge gaps, and demand for AI education and implementation.
